title: Gastops and Bell sign memorandum of understanding to explore future collaboration opportunities
summary: Announced at the Canadian Aerospace Summit 2026, the MOU establishes a framework for discussions focused on in-service support solutions, capability expansion, and the application of advanced drivetrain health monitoring technologies for current and future Bell aircraft programs.
body_markdown:
Gastops and Bell Textron Inc. (Bell) have signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to explore opportunities for future collaboration related to Bell’s industrial participation activities in Canada.


Announced at the[Canadian Aerospace Summit 2026](https://u21217919.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.hNOgNytL2Sfk7BB3MrSk5QGVDKVX3KcWRBuh3K80KP1RGLi0C6GFCdCak346t7dn-2FEtFyt9NU7Za62GQpw2FyzUYNpT-2FdnUHIPl2k9dTvT86u0MOicRdH-2Bnsn3kCPtdBOynGSvMsEO76ARgIAvJup7IYhhZuOrNVRxFah5-2B7TLWvF8i826x9E-2FCYc3Bt828CHev5qpsAqw54yXhABw8O71sXC7cQHmMx9QPX6jwIFIqAmRGQlrZ5fNmBIMaKZxunR1fo_3Njj853Hxr120e7qWk68ZduavrXYSitVigtztRuqKEtu1imYBa6Eb6U8PBmzbtbIPrTuvi-2FYSgGanTw-2BwljTMNpqmDJaRv5XphzWzH0lg1hKVc2td4OwrRKQUJxO-2BFYNVdXPYVH5H9SHdnbT8j6VT8gbnxf5MI-2Bxl6JkepMRvGbVgQBFCxuZvn-2BgSuNEpeVSvFtx3Z-2BxHATyR5CdL3pi-2FQ-3D-3D) , the MOU establishes a framework for discussions focused on in-service support solutions, capability expansion, and the application of advanced drivetrain health monitoring technologies for current and future Bell aircraft programs.


“Gastops has a long history of developing technologies that help operators better understand the condition and performance of mission-critical equipment,” said Shaun Horning, president and CEO of Gastops.


“We are pleased to explore opportunities with Bell that leverage our combined expertise and support the long-term success of aerospace programs and operators. This collaboration also creates an opportunity to further showcase the advanced technologies and engineering expertise being developed and supported here in Canada.”


“We look forward to exploring opportunities with Gastops that support Bell programs, strengthen our Canadian industrial participation, and create long-term value for customers and operators,” said Jeffrey Schloesser, senior vice president, Strategic Pursuits, at Bell.


“This collaboration will support efforts to deliver aircraft that meet the sustainability and readiness needs of our customers.”


The agreement builds upon the complementary capabilities of both organizations.


Bell brings over[90](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/rotor+x/90) years of aerospace leadership and aircraft manufacturing expertise, while Gastops has more than 45 years of experience in condition monitoring, diagnostics, prognostics, and equipment health intelligence.


“Innovation happens when organizations combine expertise to solve complex operational challenges,” said Daniel Obedi, vice president, Aerospace Platforms at Gastops.


“This MOU creates an opportunity to explore how advanced health monitoring technologies can contribute to aircraft availability, reliability, and long-term sustainment for current and future platforms.”


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Gastops.*
